A curse has plagued the Hammand family for thousands of years with Oliver Hammand and his sister Swanhild being the last of the line. What does the curse of the Undying Monster have to do with the hidden room of Oliver's and Swanhild's ancestor, Magnus the Warlock?
Godofredo Morgan, un joven con un presente regalado y un futuro prometedor al abrigo de su rico tío William W. Kolderup y prometido a su amada Fina tiene todo lo que desea, ¿o no?.

Kisch dokumentiert in seinen autobiografischen Aufzeichnungen schonungslos den soldatischen Alltag während des österreichisch-serbischen Feldzugs von 1914. Auch über ein Jahrhundert nach ihrem Erscheinen haben diese Texte nichts von ihrer Relevanz eingebüßt: Sie konfrontieren uns mit der ganzen Sinnlosigkeit kriegerischer Auseinandersetzungen – und zugleich mit den hohlen Parolen der Kriegs(be)treiber.

The Black Cat (1895-1922) was a monthly literary magazine, publishing original short stories, often about uncanny or fantastical topics. Many writers were largely unknown, but some famous authors also wrote original material for this magazine.
A play in four acts of Kenneth Grahame’s book The Wind in the Willows , created by A. A.

Monsieur de Bougrelon est un roman court de Jean Lorrain publié en 1897. Il raconte l'histoire de deux voyageurs français à Amsterdam qui rencontrent un compatriote excentrique, Monsieur de Bougrelon, dans un bordel.
Brazil is the land of the giant among all the rivers of the world. It is the land of giant fruits and giant flowers.
Grantland Rice was an American poet and sportswriter. In these poems he remembers his time in France during the First World War.

Scotland's Story: A History Of Scotland For Boys And Girls is both a history of Scotland as well as delving into some of its legends. Written with younger readers in mind, it begins with the legend of Prince Gathelus and continues through King George IV (1762 —1830).

This biography of Houdini is based on Harry's many autobiographical fragments, diary entries, clippings of the era, as well as memories left by his wife, Beatrice, who married Harry when he was nineteen and remained with him as spouse and co-worker until Harry's death at age 52. Conjunto de cuentos e historias de los indios Araucanos (Mapuches) en las pampas alreadedor del Río de la Plata. Veremos la historia de vida del llamado Cacique Blanco, entrelazada con las historias de varios personajes, en un maravilloso caleidoscopio de cuentos, cultura, aventuras, leyendas. (Introducción por mpinedag)

This monograph is more than the story of Marine expeditionary operations in Afghanistan. It describes who our nation's enemies are; how America became involved in the Global War on Terrorism; and how the Marine Corps struggled to acquire a major role in Operation Enduring Freedom, as well as the actions of Marines and sailors who helped prosecute the air and ground campaigns against Taliban and al-Qaeda forces. - Exc
A collection of poems by novelist, short story writer and poet Henry Herbert Knibbs. Another of his books of verse, "Songs of the Outlands", is also in the Librivox catalog. - Summary by Brian Fullen

Edgar Poe es reconocido por sus cuentos de terror pues varios de ellos fueron llevados al cine por actores como Peter Cushing, Christopher Lee y Peter Lorre que estaban en sus años de apogeo enrolados en las películas de esa categoría en especial. Es un autor con gran capacidad analítica y sostenía que cualquier código creado por el ingenio humano podía ser descifrado.

John 1:1 through 5:47 -- "As then we should all run together if we saw one from above bend down on a sudden from the height of heaven, promising to describe exactly all things there, even so let us be disposed now...For the words of John are nothing to those who do not desire to be freed from this swinish life, just as the things of this world to him are nothing." (Summary from the Preface by St John Chrysostom)
In 1844, Charles Nordhoff joined the U.S. Navy at the young age of 14.

Young cowboy Roy Bradner is sent by his ailing father to check on some of his rental properties in New York City. On the train ride a little run-in with some swindlers leaves him with a new friend, and several new enemies.
The everyday doings, special occasions and tall tales of Cactus Center as related in verse by famed cowboy poet Arthur Chapman, author of Out Where the West Begins. (Summary by Brian Fullen)
The Lays of Ancient Rome are four narrative poems by the English historian and politician Thomas Babington Macaulay. Each poem tells a famous story from Rome's mythic history.

In the years preceding the French Revolution, the reputation of Queen Marie Antoinette was severely harmed by the publication of details relating to a certain "scandal," involving a Roman Cardinal, a Royal jeweler, and an unscrupulous young woman looking for wealth and prestige. Carlyle, in his typical, wonderfully colorful prose, relates the tale of "The Diamond Necklace" for posterity in this small volume.
In this book, Father Müller breaks down why prayer is so important and how man can use it to maintain his relationship with God.
This is the second poetry collection of the poet-critic John Crowe Ransom, who was a member of the Fugitives and the Agrarians.
The Big Midget is the hit of the show in Jake Justus's night club, until someone puts an abrupt end to the Midget. Why were eleven unmatched silk stockings used as a noose?
British Major Crespin, his wife Lucilla and their pilot, Dr. Traherne, survive a forced landing of their aircraft in the remote Himalayan kingdom of Rukh.

The Michigan Historical Society solicited accounts by Michigan pioneers about the early settlement of various locations, or early development of institutions in Michigan. Many of these accounts were read to members of the society in the 1870s at its regular meetings or at local pioneer organization meetings.
A timeless collection of beloved children's tales, beautifully adapted by Mary Stone and brought to life with enchanting illustrations by John R. Neill.
A collection of short stories for children, written by Laura Rountree Smith. - Summary by Anne O'Donoghue

An impassioned plea by Wilberforce about putting an end to slavery in the West Indies based on his view of the institution as a national disgrace and a moral hazard. He emphasized the need for British citizens to take action and demand an end to the practice as well as highlighting the need for religious leaders to step up and teach Christianity to slaves all across the West Indies.

According to its foreword, the publication was designed to be "a new statement of the fundamentals of Christianity." Angelina Weld Grimké was a poet, playwright and educator. These poems were published between 1923 and 1927. - Summary by Newgatenovelist

Every one will see at once that we have here a new member of the family of Black Beauty and Beautiful Joe , only this time it is a bird that is the hero and the object is reform through early impressions of one of woman’s greatest weaknesses—millinery. It is one of the best stories of its class we have met with. - Summary by B.B.
In Shakespeare's Henry IV, Falstaff gets involved in quelling a rebellion and gains Hal's disfavor for doing the job so poorly and pocketing most of the funds. This is not that story.

“A Treatise on Images will not be out of place in a public which is confusing the making of images with the making of idols. A great Christian of the eighth century found himself called upon to face an imperial Iconoclast, Leo the Isaurian, who waged war against holy images, on the plausible pretext that they withdrew honour from God.

We first met the scheming Marplot in Susanna Centlivre's 1709 play "The Busie Body" (already recorded at Librivox). The play was so successful that Centlivre wrote a sequel, again putting Marplot in the middle of schemes, mistaken identities, confusion, and finally .... well, that would be telling. - Summary by ToddHW Cast list: Marplot.
Eleven fun tales from Japan for young and old folks. - Summary by kirk202

Dieses Reise und Seefahrer Abenteuer erzählt die Geschichte von einem jungen Mann, der als Kind den Eltern geraubt worden ist und unter Zigeunern aufwächst. Er geräht an die See und lernt die Seefahrt, die ihn auf viele Abenteuer führt. - Summary by Katharina21

The Set-Up is the classic epic hard-edged poem of an aging African American boxer who is set up to take a fall in the ring against a younger white opponent. But when he finds out the fix is in, he decides he wants to go down swinging.

Plunge into the wonderful world of water-closets (a.k.a. toilets) with Virginia architect Glenn Brown. Follow the evolution of the humble toilet, from ancient sanitation to Victorian plumbing, and discover how the 'royal throne' helped reshape public health, urban design, and modern hygiene. - Summary by Carrie Mae Streb

Great Captains Unveiled by the eminent military historian Sir Basil Liddell Hart comprises the biographies of six commanders who shaped the development of strategy and tactics. This children's book, written by the author of "The Velveteen Rabbit", tells the story of Cecco, an adventurous and spirited wooden dog, who gets out of the toy cupboard and experiences many adventures with Bulka, the rag puppy, and other toy characters from the toy storage. - Summary by Mark Harrington
